nodes.name: Fetch All Existing Sheet Records
nodes.notes: One read per run, not one per invoice. Feeds the duplicate check.

filters.q: is:unread newer_than:14d -label:novus-not-invoice -label:novus-processed (invoice OR invoices OR invoicing OR billing OR payment OR statement OR receipt OR "fee note" OR factuur OR filename:pdf)

nodes.name: Search Unread Invoice Emails
nodes.notes: The two -label: terms are the cost control. A mail already triaged as not-an-invoice carries novus-not-invoice and is filtered out BY GMAIL, so it is never downloaded and never reaches a paid node. Label names must match exactly, lowercase, spaces written as dashes.

nodes.name: Extract From PDF File
nodes.notes: On Error = Continue. A corrupt PDF becomes an error ITEM the next node classifies, instead of killing the run.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-5', max_tokens: 1500, output_config: { effort: 'low' }, system: $('Re-attach PDF Binary').item.json.ocr_system_prompt, messages: [ { role: 'user', content: [ { type: 'document', source: { type: 'base64', media_type: 'application/pdf', data: ($json.pdf_base64 || $json.data) } }, { type: 'text', text: 'Read this scanned invoice and return the flat JSON object defined in the system prompt. Email subject: ' + ($('Re-attach PDF Binary').item.json.subject || '') + '. Filename: ' + ($('Re-attach PDF Binary').item.json.attachment_filename || '') + '.' } ] } ] }) }}

nodes.name: Claude Vision OCR
nodes.notes: Sends the PDF itself as a base64 document block so Claude reads the page visually. Retries 3x with a 5s backoff, which is what recovers a 429 or a 529 overload. Anything still failing after that is caught by On Error and logged as a failed row.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'nvidia/llama-3.3-nemotron-super-49b-v1.5', messages: [ { role: 'system', content: $json.extraction_system_prompt }, { role: 'user', content: $json.claude_input + '\n\nReturn ONLY a JSON object with exactly these keys: is_invoice, not_invoice_reason, vendor_name, invoice_number, invoice_date, due_date, total_amount, currency, description, is_credit_note.' } ], temperature: 0, top_p: 1, max_tokens: 1200, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, stream: false }) }}

nodes.name: Nemotron Text Extractor (A/B)
nodes.notes: A/B alternative to Claude Text Extractor. LEFT UNCONNECTED ON PURPOSE. A disabled node in n8n passes its input straight through to its output, so wiring it in parallel produced a second, empty item and a phantom failure row for every email. To A/B: delete the Prepare Claude Input -> Claude Text Extractor link, then connect Prepare Claude Input -> this node -> Standardize Text Result. Reads the SAME system prompt from $json.extraction_system_prompt so both models get identical instructions.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'nvidia/llama-3.1-nemotron-nano-vl-8b-v1', messages: [ { role: 'system', content: $json.ocr_system_prompt }, { role: 'user', content: [ { type: 'text', text: 'Read this scanned invoice and return the JSON object described in the system prompt.' }, { type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: 'data:image/png;base64,' + ($json.page_png_base64 || '') } } ] } ], temperature: 0, top_p: 1, max_tokens: 1200, stream: false }) }}

nodes.name: Nemotron Vision OCR (A/B)
nodes.notes: A/B alternative to Claude Vision OCR. LEFT UNCONNECTED ON PURPOSE - see the note on the Nemotron Text Extractor. To A/B: replace the PDF to Base64 -> Claude Vision OCR link with a link to this node. It also cannot run until something produces $json.page_png_base64: NVIDIA vision endpoints take base64 PNG or JPEG, not PDF.

parameters.jsonExample:
{
  "is_invoice": true,
  "not_invoice_reason": null,
  "vendor_name": "Meridian Plumbing & HVAC",
  "invoice_number": "INV-4471",
  "invoice_date": "2026-08-10",
  "due_date": "2026-09-09",
  "total_amount": 2480.0,
  "currency": "USD",
  "description": "Emergency boiler repair at 14 Ashford Court and quarterly HVAC servicing",
  "is_credit_note": false
}

nodes.name: Claude Text Extractor
nodes.notes: One retry only, with a 5s backoff. A retry here is a second BILLED Claude call, so this is deliberately not set higher: it is here to ride out a rate limit, not to brute-force a bad prompt.

nodes.name: Anthropic Chat Model (Haiku)
nodes.notes: Haiku: lifting labelled fields out of clean text is a small model's job. The vision path is the only place a larger model earns its price.

nodes.name: Log This Item?
nodes.notes: True = write a row (a real invoice, or a failure worth recording). False = a genuine non-invoice email, which is ignored. Renamed from 'Is Genuine Invoice?' because failures pass through it too, and calling them genuine invoices was misleading.

nodes.name: Validate Fields & Check Duplicates
nodes.notes: Sets Processing Status to one of processed / processed_with_warnings / failed. processed_with_warnings means the row IS logged but named fields were absent from the document - Error Note lists exactly which ones. Blank means the document did not say, never a guess.

nodes.name: Append Invoice Row to Sheet
nodes.notes: Append or Update matching on Row Key, NOT plain Append. This is what makes retrying a write safe: a retry after a partial write re-targets the same row instead of adding a second one.

nodes.name: Collect Message IDs (Unique)
nodes.notes: Deduplicates to one Gmail call per message and decides which label the message earns. If any attachment on an email produced a row, the whole email counts as processed - an invoice is never filed away as not-an-invoice because a flyer rode along with it.

nodes.name: Add Processed Label
nodes.notes: labelIds must be a Gmail LABEL ID (Label_xxxxxxxx), never the display name. Pick it from the dropdown.

nodes.name: Mark Message as Read
nodes.notes: Takes the id from the collector rather than from the label node's output, so a label failure cannot poison this step.

nodes.name: Was It an Invoice?
nodes.notes: True = an invoice, a failure or a duplicate: file it under Processed and mark it read. False = not an invoice: label it Novus/Not-Invoice and LEAVE IT UNREAD, so it still shows up for an admin but can never be pulled back into the workflow.

nodes.name: Add Not-Invoice Label
nodes.notes: Create the label in Gmail as 'novus-not-invoice' and pick its ID from the dropdown - the name must match the -label: term in the Gmail search node. Terminal on purpose: there is no mark-as-read after it, so the mail stays unread in the admin's inbox. If this call fails the mail is simply picked up again next run - it is never lost.
